sentences.en: The prominent poet attempted to commit suicide in his study.
sentences.zh: 著名诗人曾在书房里试图自杀。

sentences.en: Without your advice, I would have failed in the attempt.
sentences.zh: 如果没有你的建议，我这次尝试就会失败。

sentences.en: He failed in his attempt to swim across the river.
sentences.zh: 他试图横渡河流但失败了。

senses.zh: 试图，努力；企图杀害；（运动员创造记录的）尝试，冲击

mnemonic: 词根记忆：at（加强）+tempt（尝试） →尝试
